observations: Photo 0: Top freezer compartment open, showing interior with shelves and a control dial. The door has a single shelf and a small compartment. The top panel appears damaged or missing parts.
Photo 1: Bottom refrigerator compartment open, showing glass shelves and a crisper drawer. The door has three transparent drawers. The interior is clean and empty except for a bottle.

Photo 2: Full view of the fridge freezer, stainless steel finish, two-door design (top freezer, bottom fridge). A blue sticker with fruit images is on the lower door. The top panel has visible damage or missing components. No brand or model visible on any photo.
The seller claims the panel was damaged due to high current, implying the fridge may not work or has electrical issues.

claims.claim: I plugged this during high current and damaged the panel.
claims.evidence: No photo shows the electrical panel or damage to it; only the top exterior appears damaged. The cause of damage is not visible.

claims.claim: A beautiful and full sized fridge freezer
claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a full-sized unit with a modern design. Photos 0 and 1 show clean, intact interiors.

risks.risk: The fridge may not work due to electrical damage to the control panel or internal components.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the control panel, power cord, and the fridge running with lights and cooling.

risks.risk: Hidden damage to the compressor or cooling system from the high current event.
risks.proof: A video of the fridge operating, including the compressor running and interior cooling.

risks.risk: The top panel damage may affect insulation or structural integrity.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the damaged top panel and surrounding area.
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic damage only, but with potential for reduced efficiency

proof_requests: Video or photo of the fridge running, showing the compressor and interior cooling.
Close-up of the control panel and power cord to assess damage.
Photo of the back of the fridge to check for damage or loose wiring.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 2-door fridge freezer, but the seller's claim of electrical damage to the panel cannot be verified from the photos. Without proof of functionality, it must be priced as not working. The damage to the top panel is visible but its impact on performance is unknown. Proof of operation is required before pricing.
